brief:
Israel is deploying artificial intelligence systems as part of its broader strategy to influence how Palestinians are perceived globally, Al Jazeera English reported. The development represents a new technological dimension in Israel's long-standing effort to control the narrative surrounding Palestinians and the conflict.

The so-called Hanover affair has brought this AI-driven approach into public view, exposing how technology is being leveraged alongside traditional media and diplomatic channels. The incident reveals the expanding scope of Israel's information operations, which now extend beyond conventional propaganda methods into machine learning and algorithmic systems designed to shape public understanding of Palestinians and related geopolitical issues.
dek: The Hanover affair exposes a new front in Israel’s long-running effort to shape how Palestinians are understood.
title: Israel weaponizes artificial intelligence to shape Palestinian narratives
